title: Display name QA
lede: Checks that a user can change their display name, that the 40-character limit holds, and that the name shows in the header. About 10 minutes. Each step lists the exact clicks, and anything you type has a Copy button.

legendText.optional: skip if you're short on time
legendText.claude: the assistant does this, not you

blocks.p: Page: @@https://staging.example.com/settings/profile|staging.example.com/settings/profile@@. PR #482 is live there (deploy of 13 Nov, 14:20 UTC).

ul: **Account.** qa-user@example.com, already signed in. If it asks, sign in with that account.
**Pasting.** Click **Copy** here, click inside the box, press {{Cmd}} {{A}}, then {{Cmd}} {{V}}.
**Saving takes two clicks.** [[Save]] opens a **Save your profile?** dialog; [[Save profile]] inside it is what saves.

blocks.small: Read from the database on 13 Nov. Step 2.2 puts it back.

blocks.label: Display name
blocks.note: Shows in Settings > Profile and in the header, top right.

parts.title: Part A. Staging as it is

steps.title: Edit and save
actions: Click [[Save]], then [[Save profile]] in the dialog.
steps.expect: The dialog **Save your profile?** shows "QA User" under [[BEFORE]] and "QA User round 1" under [[AFTER]]. After [[Save profile]] a green [[SAVED]] tag shows for about 3 seconds, and the header reads "QA User round 1" without a reload.

steps.title: The 40-character limit
steps.expect: Only 40 characters go in, the counter reads "40 / 40" in amber, and [[Save]] stays enabled.

steps.title: Discard the long name
actions: Click [[Cancel]], then [[Discard changes]] in the dialog.
steps.expect: The dialog is **Discard your changes?** After [[Discard changes]] the box reads "QA User round 1" again.

actions.text: Paste the starting value into [[Display name]]:

steps.title: Tell Claude "QA done"
actions: Say "QA done". If anything failed, click [[Copy results]] at the top and paste it in too.
steps.expect: Claude checks, read only, that the display name is "QA User" again and that the profile history shows only the saves you made.
